title: Replanning & skills — run slow to run fast
intro: The step between features that most teams skip — and why the course treats it as the engine of speed.

steps.title: A normal step, not an apology
steps.body:
Between features, pause **on a dedicated replanning branch** and reflect. The framing: **run slow to run fast** — refine the constitution, tune the process, set the next feature up for success.

Keeping constitution updates on their own branch also tracks *which version of the specs produced which code*.

steps.title: Three radii
steps.body: Replanning can touch a feature, the project, or the way you work:

points.label: A feature
points.note: Adjust one feature's spec — a course correction.

points.label: The project
points.note: The course's pass: add Vitest to tech-stack.md and CASCADE it — config, an extracted app module, then a real test suite for the Phase-1 criteria. Plus roadmap housekeeping: phases 2–5 hung together, so they merged into one.

points.label: The workflow
points.note: Improve HOW you work: package repeated prompts into skills that outlive the project.

steps.title: Absorbing product changes
steps.body:
Mid-project curveball (responsive design)? Tell the agent to update **product specs + all feature specs + code** in one pass — the fix landed as a viewport meta, mobile-first CSS, and a new test.

> [!tip] The judgment call: **small + early → implement during replanning. Big → its own roadmap phase.** Specs capture *decisions*, not just code.

steps.title: Skills: when a prompt earns a package
steps.body:
Retyping the same long prompt is the signal. A **skill** is a reusable package of instructions and resources that gives the agent a repeatable capability — and agents have skill-creators, so let the agent write it while you watch its choices.

The course's example: a `/changelog` skill that updates CHANGELOG.md before every merge, created once, used everywhere — global skills work **across all projects**. Other candidates: a validation bundle (lint, format, tests, README refresh).

recap:
**Replanning is scheduled reflection with teeth.**

- Own branch; three radii: feature, project, workflow.
- Cascade constitution changes through specs AND code in one pass.
- Small + early changes land during replanning; big ones become phases.
- A retyped prompt is a skill waiting to be written — let the agent write it.
